body.name: Matched-date-block diagonal covariance
body.construction: \((\Sigma_{\mathrm{diag}})_{(g,t),(h,s)}=\mathbf 1\{t=s\}(\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}})_{(g,t),(h,t)}\), and \(Z^{\mathrm{diag}}\sim\mathcal N(Kx,\Sigma_{\mathrm{diag}})\). Thus each entire within-date score covariance is matched and dependence across distinct dates is deleted.
